mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, dormitory_id, description, status, handler_id, result, create_time, accept_time, finish_time, update_time FROM repair_record WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, student_id, dormitory_id, description, status, handler_id, result, create_time, accept_time, finish_time, update_time FROM repair_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, student_id, dormitory_id, description, status, handler_id, result, create_time, accept_time, finish_time, update_time FROM repair_record ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repair_record (student_id, dormitory_id, description, status, handler_id, result, create_time, accept_time, finish_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{dormitoryId}, #{description}, #{status}, #{handlerId}, #{result}, #{createTime}, #{acceptTime}, #{finishTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_record SET status = 'ACCEPTED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, accept_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE repair_record SET status = 'FIXED', handler_id = #{handlerId}, result = #{result}, finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
